items.text: Morning: Higashiyama walk (K1), no guide
Leave the hotel.
Up Gojō-zaka and Chawan-zaka to the Kiyomizu-dera gate. Or taxi ~10 min.
Stage, Okuno-in view, Otowa waterfall (drink from one stream only). ¥500. 📿 stamp desk may be closed at 7:00: try on the way out.
Down Kiyomizu-zaka, right into the Sannenzaka steps.
Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka, almost empty. Gourd shop at the bottom of the steps.
Up Yasaka-dōri for the pagoda photo.
Nene-no-michi north; the lane is on the left.
Opens 9:00 (¥600). Garden, dragon corridor, Otamaya, bamboo.
Tea ceremony on Ninenzaka, if booked (sessions start ~10:00, so it delays the afternoon).
East route (K8), no guide
Walk to Higashiyama Stn (~10 min), Tōzai Line → Keage (1 stop); exit 1, brick tunnel to Nanzen-ji. Or walk ~35 min via Chion-in and Shōren-in.
Sanmon gate (¥600, climb), Hōjō garden (¥600), Suirokaku aqueduct (free).
Yudōfu lunch near Nanzen-ji (e.g. Okutan or Junsei), chosen on the spot.
Only if the queue is short: ¥1,500, reception until 16:00. 10 min walk north of Nanzen-ji.
To Nyakuōji-bashi, the south end of the path.
North along the canal. 📿 stamps at Ōtoyo Shrine and Hōnen-in (just off the path).
One-way garden loop (¥1,000). Hill path viewpoint over the pavilion.
Back: taxi to the hotel or Gion, or bus 5/17/203 from Ginkakuji-michi.
Free after ~16:30. Dinner in Gion, chosen on the spot, or K16 (open Mondays) / K15 if booked.
Wagyu sukiyaki, last entry 19:30. Needs a reservation.
